## Voluntary enquiry flow
A person requests contact and receives a clearly scoped acknowledgement draft. Ask one relevant question at a time, stop on refusal and hand uncertain requests to a human. Store only the required consent and status information. No WhatsApp message is sent, and template availability or account approval must be checked separately.
